title: The Gate Camp After Sunset

candidates.title: A steady watery portal with broad rolling motion
candidates.action: The open surface rolls slowly with darker pockets and pearl-blue highlights, retaining fine texture underneath.
candidates.method: Convert V2 into a real60s periodic surface with bounded source-valid deformation and matched boundary velocity. Avoid a spinning texture or repeated activation burst.
candidates.acceptance: Broad motion reads in the full scene without glitter noise, ring deformation or a detectable reset.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Portal light that reaches the surrounding set
candidates.action: The same surface wave lights stair treads, rail edges and nearby stone; a restrained blue rim reaches appropriate camp objects.
candidates.method: Use the portal emission field for hand-mapped receiver masks with material/facing/falloff differences. The warm lantern remains the foreground counterlight.
candidates.acceptance: Blue movement is visible on real surfaces at720p, follows the portal and does not wash the whole frame blue.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Cloud layers crossing the alien sky
candidates.action: Cloud edges travel behind spires and in front of selected distant haze while the large world and small moon stay fixed.
candidates.method: Separate source-safe sky runs and planet/spire exclusions; advect coherent texture and hide local renewals.
candidates.acceptance: Recognizable travel is visible across the open sky; neither world nor rock fragments enter moving samples.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Wind in depth: basin air and low ground streamers
candidates.action: Distant basin haze moves slowly while an occasional nearer dry-air tongue crosses the approach around the rocks.
candidates.method: Depth-specific sizes/speeds and shared gust cues; stone, steps, path lamps and the camp chair occlude the ground layer.
candidates.acceptance: Far and near movement are both readable, with no straight fog boundary or opaque band across the valley.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Canopy fabric breathing between its supports
candidates.action: A soft gust lifts the broad cloth folds while seams, poles and fixed attachments hold their positions.
candidates.method: Start with a source-bound mesh deformation of interior cloth folds. Free-edge movement requires a clean revealed sky patch and a separate test.
candidates.acceptance: A broad fold visibly responds to wind without dragging poles, stretching seams or revealing a duplicate cloth edge.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: A loose strap and selected scrub responding to gusts
candidates.action: A verified loose strap twitches and one small scrub clump leans with stronger gusts.
candidates.method: Distinguish free webbing from taut guy lines. Separate movable tips over clean background where silhouettes move; keep the motion subordinate to the canopy.
candidates.acceptance: The same gust drives cloth and vegetation; tensioned lines remain believable and no original silhouette is doubled.
candidates.asset_requirement: Requires precise movable-element isolation; omit a component that cannot be cleanly reconstructed.

candidates.title: Warm lantern and path-light presence
candidates.action: Keep a strong warm place to sit, with a rare short practical-light dip and attached spill on canvas, case and ground.
candidates.method: Trace complete white cores and local lit surfaces. Most path lights stay steady; any lamp event uses a long independent clock.
candidates.acceptance: Warm core and spill respond together without fire-like flicker on an electric lantern or synchronized path flashing.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Blue surface reflections on the ring and rail hardware
candidates.action: Portal ripples add moving cool highlights to the inner ring lip, rails and appropriate carved metal.
candidates.method: Tight material/facing masks driven by G01. Preserve the already-open gate state and steady warm chevron identity.
candidates.acceptance: Metal reads as lit metal with stationary carvings; no floating halo, moving glyphs or mechanical redial every minute.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Live survey map on the laptop
candidates.action: A small route marker, restrained scan and occasional status-line refresh animate the existing map.
candidates.method: Perspective-map inside the current screen; retain its original map texture and bezel. Use expedition telemetry rather than a prominent decorative waveform.
candidates.acceptance: Readable activity stays inside the angled display; no laptop, keyboard or floor movement.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: A radio receive indicator on the real device
candidates.action: A source-mounted receive indicator and small meter acknowledge occasional communications.
candidates.method: Select a real screen/lens on the device; use short held acknowledgements on a long event clock, optionally linked to a later radio SFX audition.
candidates.acceptance: Light is attached to hardware and survives720p; no random key sparkle or mandatory chatter.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Mug steam after a small geometry repair
candidates.action: A few fine warm wisps rise from a correctly formed mug and disperse into the open air.
candidates.method: Repair the duplicated handle first, freeze the new plate/hash, then trace cup/rim and use irregular source-anchored steam.
candidates.acceptance: One coherent mug handle, correct rim attachment, visible quiet steam and no changes outside the repair/effect masks.
candidates.asset_requirement: The existing source has handles on both sides; prepare a confined repair before this effect or any final plate lock.

candidates.title: A rare expedition rover near the approach
candidates.action: A small wheeled survey rover makes a quiet approach along verified clear ground and settles by the expedition staging area.
candidates.method: Requires a convincing asset, projected wheel contact/suspension, local shadows and solid rock/rail/chair occlusion. Keep it a rare narrative beat.
candidates.acceptance: The rover sits on the uneven ground at the right scale and never cuts through steps or railings; the gate remains the main subject.
candidates.asset_requirement: New reviewed rover asset and source-space ground/occlusion setup. Do after the base environment is accepted; defer human portal crossings.

knowledge_reuse.use: Normal-size readability, bright bounded emitter cores/longer holds, source-linked spill, true road placement and premultiplied tiny-asset edges.
knowledge_reuse.limit: Positive V5 feedback; no transferable numeric gains or automatic approval for a new source.

knowledge_reuse.use: Separate absolute attention clock from a shorter environmental phase; keep event clocks continuous across chunks.
knowledge_reuse.limit: The600s schedule is a proposal, not implemented long-animation evidence.

knowledge_reuse.use: Source and destination occlusion, source-tap checks, full structure context and matching light core/spill.
knowledge_reuse.limit: New scene geometry needs new masks; scene approval does not transfer.

knowledge_reuse.use: Different depth speeds and one cue envelope shared by visible weather and sound.
knowledge_reuse.limit: Borrow the method, not sandstorm density, strike count or source-specific levels.

knowledge_reuse.use: Inward glass masks, surface-preserving motion and restrained mapped display activity.
knowledge_reuse.limit: Source-specific techniques; Shoreless rejected the large waveform, and isolated numeric checks are not playback approval.

gates: Audit the exact original art and current encoded baseline; freeze hashes before any source repair.
Trace both sampled-source support and output protection, plus solid foreground occluders. Planning pins are not effect masks.
Eight-to-twelve-second isolated tests at full composition and actual frame rate, followed by one combined visible core pass.
Inspect unamplified720p at1x plus native crops; then an A/B with matching viewpoint and disclosed timing changes.
No camera drift, whole-scene dissolve, geometry wobble, synchronized skyline/room exposure or unmotivated repeated dramatic events.
Build a genuine60s environmental cycle and a separate600s attention clock; validate states/velocity/occlusion at joins and across chunks.
Decode every frame and timestamp, compare native-to-encoded controls and regional seam steps, and keep user playback acceptance separate.
Render accepted native-frame effects directly to4K with explicitBT709/TV handling and disclosed source upscaling; current intro once at assembly.
